about: Each mutant of tests/test_waivers_render.py::test_guard_fails_on_broken_builds (mirrored; tests/test_waivers_mutation_specificity.py compares them with the suite's source), the diagnostic its own check must report (regex, whole line after the [Npx] tag, at every width listed), the consequences of the same breakage that may also appear (each with a reason), and the verdict expected once JEG-1282 (#1149) is on main: all eight killed. At 430791c4 two were harness failures; each entry's `note` says how. An entry with `values` also requires its `values` group to be in that order (a sort diagnostic's numbers). A designated or consequence pattern never accounts for a page error.

consequences.pattern: empty tab headline 'Values are still loading\.'
consequences.why: the empty-tab check reads the same <b>; with setText removed it keeps the shell's placeholder

designated.pattern: phone layout: table True cards True count \d+

consequences.why: the ten-column table shown at 390 px is wider than the screen

consequences.pattern: controls under 44 px on the Waivers tab \(\d+ checked\): \["button#\. '(?:Candidate|DDF Value|Value above waivers|Market value|Starter change|Bench change|Verdict)' \d+x32"(?:, "button#\. '(?:Candidate|DDF Value|Value above waivers|Market value|Starter change|Bench change|Verdict)' \d+x32")*\]
consequences.why: the table's sortable header buttons (no id or class, the 32 px min-height of `thead th button`) become visible at phone width; only those labels at that height may be listed, so a search-result button or another small control stays a harness failure
the ascending check also compares aria-sort, which is still missing after the second click; the values themselves must still be ascending with dashes last

no aria-sort.note: At 430791c4 the suite removed only the setAttribute call, leaving `if (S.sort.key === col.id)` to guard the header-button block; the click timed out (TimeoutError) and the old guard counted it. JEG-1282 (#1149) removes the whole statement.

dashes sorted first.find: return nx ? 1 : -1;   // dashes last, whichever way

designated.pattern: the league-settings event did not redraw the tab
table role None labelled by v2WaiversHeadline
controls under 44 px on the Waivers tab \(\d+ checked\): \["button#\.v2-link v2-wv-remove 'Remove' \d+x20"(?:, "button#\.v2-link v2-wv-remove 'Remove' \d+x20")*\]

consequences.pattern: the defense row: \{'name': '[^']+', 'pos': 'DEF', 'ddf': '— ?no value', 'vaw': '— ?no value', 'market': '— ?no value', 'starter': '— ?no value', 'bench': '— ?no value', 'drop': '— ?no value', 'verdict': '', 'reason': '[^']+: kickers and defenses are not evaluated\.'\}
consequences.why: the defense check also wants the 'Not evaluated' verdict text, which this mutant removes; every value cell must still be a dash and the reason must still say not evaluated, so only the verdict differs

consequences.pattern: the Verdict header does not return to the ranked order
consequences.why: after the Verdict header click the check reads the first row's verdict text, which is now empty

consequences.pattern: a card has no verdict banner
consequences.why: the phone card's banner is the same verdictTag (waivers.js:709), now empty

no verdict text.note: At 430791c4 check() appended the verdict-cells diagnostic and then raised ValueError on order.index(''), so run_checks never returned and the old guard counted the exception. JEG-1282 (#1149) ranks only known verdicts.

browser unavailable.how: CHROMIUM_PATH points at a plain text file, so Chromium cannot launch; run once with RENDER_TESTS_REQUIRED=1 (RuntimeError) and once without (SkipTest).

navigation timeout.how: waivers.js polls the page every 100 ms, so page.goto never reaches networkidle and times out.

unrelated page error.how: waivers.js throws from a timer after the module has run.
unrelated page error.append: setTimeout(function () { throw new Error("JEG-1279 injected unrelated page error"); }, 0);

unrelated diagnostic.how: Two real mutants at once, judged as the first: the second one's diagnostic is unrelated to it.
